# Historical scene execution audit

**Provenance.** All citations refer to expanded files under `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r1/`. Their archive members have the same relative paths prefixed `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r1/`. The generic C2 test files are in `work/scene_archive/bundles/r1--generic_rsi.tar.gz`; the pilot C1 development files are in `work/scene_archive/bundles/r1--scene_rsi_pilot.tar.gz`, under the same project root. Citations below give source ID, relative expanded file and exact lines.

## Dormitory: commons_163096530

The step-3 code constructs plaster and timber architecture, 115 separate floorboards, three rotated left bunks and a cropped foreground bunk, a wooden panel, wardrobe, masonry hearth, accessories and clock. Bunks use solid mattress boxes and separate rods for posts, rails and ladders; their coordinates describe intended assemblies, not verified contact. [X0605, `generic_rsi/C2/test/commons_163096530/steps/003/build.py`, lines 32–159]

After realization, generated-coordinate noise, ramps and bump are assigned to floor meshes and high fireplace meshes; a later loop sets node-material roughness to 0.78. The camera is `(2.65,-5.5,2.15)`, aimed at `(-.42,3.25,1.15)`, lens 37; two area lights, world strength 0.40 and AgX are specified. [X0605, same file, lines 18–20, 163–228]

The author's prior-step comparison estimated distant fixtures too low; it is an observation in the code, not independent verification of step 3. The reference metadata is 512×341. Blender 4.2.10 reports step 3 successful, empty stderr, 16/16 samples, and saved PNG and blend files. This is a completed render, not proof of visual fidelity; no selection or acceptance record for this scene is supplied. [X0605, same file, lines 5–16; X0607, `generic_rsi/C2/test/commons_163096530/task.json`, lines 2–5; X0606, `generic_rsi/C2/test/commons_163096530/steps/003/result.json`, lines 2–7]

## Woodworking room: commons_199974832

The code represents a window, four back and return shelf bands, numerous individual planes, open measuring-tool arms, a solid workbench, loose tools, pot, bottle and a cylindrical “bowl” with swept curls. Planes have separate solid sole, body and inclined iron; detailed foreground examples add rod handles. These are primitive approximations, and placement alone establishes neither support nor image likeness. [X0616, `generic_rsi/C2/test/commons_199974832/steps/003/build.py`, lines 55–95, 97–168, 181–237]

Step 1 used lens 31; step 2 changed it to 36 and extended walls to address an alleged sky band. Step 3 retained camera `(-.45,-5.35,2.62)` and target `(.05,1.05,1.99)`, but darkened colors and explicitly reassigned cached node finishes through named primitive ancestry. Wood-like colors receive mapped noise and a color ramp; dark near-neutral finishes receive metallic 0.55. World strength is 0.42, with 1050- and 650-power area lights and AgX. These are code operations, not measured appearance. [X0612, `generic_rsi/C2/test/commons_199974832/steps/001/build.py`, lines 15–26; X0614, `generic_rsi/C2/test/commons_199974832/steps/002/build.py`, lines 8–22, 44–49; X0616, same step-3 file, lines 18–35, 251–311]

All three step results report success, empty stderr, 16 samples and saved images/blend files; the record lists CPU execution. The separate selection file names step 3, although the record's `selected` field is null. Recorded validity and functional passes concern structural/edit operability; semantic completeness and support/collision truth are null. Metrics include SSIM 0.0993 and overall 0.3865, not independent acceptance of visual quality. Reference metadata is 512×384. [X0613, `generic_rsi/C2/test/commons_199974832/steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0615, corresponding `steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0617, corresponding `steps/003/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0609, `generic_rsi/C2/test/commons_199974832/record.json`, lines 16–38, 47–57; X0610, corresponding `selected.json`, lines 1–3; X0618, corresponding `task.json`, lines 2–5]

## Chaise room: commons_109923183

Step 1 timed out after approximately 600 seconds with no image or output: a technical execution failure, not a poor-render judgment. The later root build says it reduced parquet and textile primitive counts while preserving major geometry and camera. It models a chaise with separate cushion, upholstery, swept rails, legs and ornaments, plus a rotated loose pillow, label and cane chair. Its support claims remain unverified. [X0624, `scene_rsi_pilot/C1/development/commons_109923183/steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0619, `scene_rsi_pilot/C1/development/commons_109923183/build.py`, lines 15–17, 40–58, 98–103, 125–185, 197–253]

The root code specifies a 62 mm camera, two area lights, Cycles 16 samples with denoising, AgX, 512×384 and roughness 0.76. The record reports completion on an A100 GPU and functional passes, but null semantic and collision truth; `selected.json` names step 2 while the record's `selected` is null. The supplied text does not include that step's execution result or image, so the record should not be mistaken for visual validation. [X0619, same build, lines 260–286; X0620, `scene_rsi_pilot/C1/development/commons_109923183/record.json`, lines 16–37, 49–68; X0621, corresponding `selected.json`, lines 1–3]
